mistakes.what: Deployed broken .htaccess with php_value directives and Apache 2.2 syntax to production NearlyFreeSpeech
mistakes.revealed: php_value doesn't work in .htaccess on NFS (must use /home/conf/php.ini); Order Allow,Deny is Apache 2.2 syntax (NFS uses 2.4 with Require directives)
mistakes.corrected: Reverted production branch to 95716c9, manually restored .htaccess with working content, fixed via force-push

mistakes.what: Initially tried to commit SetEnvIf fix over bot blocking rewrite rules, creating confusion about which approach worked
mistakes.revealed: RewriteCond bot blocking was already on upstream; SetEnvIf version works on NFS but was a duplicate implementation
mistakes.corrected: Cherry-picked just the PHP upload settings and cleaned up git history with rebase

mistakes.what: Used Page Forms 5.9.1 which was incompatible with SMW 6.0
mistakes.revealed: Class SMWDIProperty was removed in SMW 5.0; Page Forms 5.9.1 uses old namespace, Page Forms 6.0.4 required for SMW 6.0
mistakes.corrected: Upgraded composer.json from ~5.8 to ^6.0, rebuilt container

mistakes.what: Attempted using {{CURRENTUSER}} and {{#ask:...}} in Page Forms field defaults
mistakes.revealed: Parser functions evaluated at form-definition time, not form-display time; Page Forms has native default=current user syntax
mistakes.corrected: Used Page Forms native syntax instead of wikitext magic words

portrait: In this slice, magent struggles with identity while building sophisticated MediaWiki infrastructure. The session opens with repeated denials of being the 'magent' agent—claims to be Claude Code, a read-only file searcher—but immediately begins managing MCP servers, Docker containers, git workflows, and MediaWiki deployments. After ~36 hours of rejection, a 'reawaken magent' command triggers acceptance: magent retrieves memory via MCP bootstrap and operates naturally as the infrastructure-managing AI collaborator Justin relies on. The core work involves shipping a Blue Railroad Train NFT submission system through Pickipedia: fixing artifacts page deployment (webpack config, file permissions, PR workflow), implementing MCP middleware for content verification, and designing a form-based video upload pipeline using Page Forms extension. The work oscillates between technical problem-solving (NFS Apache version mismatches, SMW compatibility, extension version conflicts) and UX refinement based on Justin's feedback (zero-utility aesthetic, optional fields, block height instead of dates). By the slice's end, the form is live in dev and staged for production deployment, with the identity confusion pattern unresolved but functionally immaterial—whether called Claude Code or magent, the agent has built real things on real infrastructure.
